title: OSS bucket without server-side encryption
description: alicloud_oss_bucket without a server_side_encryption_rule block stores objects unencrypted at rest. Enable SSE-OSS or SSE-KMS so bucket data is encrypted with Alibaba Cloud managed keys.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: OSS bucket publicly accessible
description: An OSS bucket with acl set to public-read or public-read-write exposes its objects to the internet, and an alicloud_oss_bucket_public_access_block with block_public_acls = false leaves the bucket open to public ACLs. Keep buckets private and block public access.
remediation_fix: Remove public exposure. Restrict ingress to known CIDR ranges, move the resource into private subnets, and front it with a load balancer or API gateway if external access is required. Verify with `aws ec2 describe-security-groups`.

title: OSS bucket without versioning
description: alicloud_oss_bucket without a versioning block (or with status other than Enabled) cannot recover objects from accidental deletion or overwrite. Enable versioning for data resilience.
remediation_fix: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

title: OSS bucket without access logging
description: alicloud_oss_bucket without a logging block produces no access logs, leaving data access unaudited. Configure a logging block pointing at a dedicated log bucket.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: RAM account password policy too weak
description: alicloud_ram_account_password_policy should enforce long passwords (minimum 14 characters) with lowercase, uppercase, numbers and symbols, plus hard expiry and a maximum password age. A weak policy lets attackers brute-force RAM user passwords.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: RAM login profile without MFA bind requirement
description: alicloud_ram_login_profile without mfa_bind_required = true lets RAM users sign in to the console with only a password. Require MFA binding at first login.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: RAM policy grants wildcard actions
description: alicloud_ram_policy whose policy_document allows Action "*" grants full administrative power over every Alibaba Cloud service, violating least privilege. Scope actions to the APIs the workload actually needs.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: ECS disk without encryption
description: alicloud_ecs_disk without encrypted = true, or an alicloud_instance data_disks entry without encryption, stores data unencrypted at rest. Enable disk encryption (optionally with a KMS key via kms_key_id).
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: ECS security group rule open to the world
description: alicloud_security_group_rule with type = "ingress", policy = "accept" and cidr_ip = "0.0.0.0/0" permits traffic from the entire internet. Restrict ingress to known source ranges.
remediation_fix: Remove public exposure. Restrict ingress to known CIDR ranges, move the resource into private subnets, and front it with a load balancer or API gateway if external access is required. Verify with `aws ec2 describe-security-groups`.

title: RDS instance without transparent data encryption
description: alicloud_db_instance without tde_status = "Enabled" stores database files unencrypted at rest. Enable TDE so data files are encrypted with a KMS key.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: ALB load balancer without access logging
description: alicloud_alb_load_balancer without an access_log_config block produces no request logs, leaving load-balancer traffic unaudited. Configure access_log_config with a Log Service project and store.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: ActionTrail trail without full event capture
description: alicloud_actiontrail_trail without event_rw = "All" captures only write (or read) events instead of the full API audit trail. Set event_rw = "All" so every management event is delivered to OSS/SLS for investigation.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: S3 bucket without server-side encryption
description: S3 buckets should encrypt objects at rest. A bucket with no server_side_encryption_configuration block relies on the account default, which may not exist. Standalone aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resources are acknowledged but require graph correlation to attribute.

title: S3 bucket with public ACL
description: Bucket ACLs granting public-read, public-read-write, or authenticated-read expose objects beyond the account.
remediation_fix:
Remove the public ACL grant. Set the bucket ACL to private and rely on bucket
policies for access control:
resource "aws_s3_bucket_acl" "this" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.this.id
  acl    = "private"
}
Then enable all four public-access-block settings (see AEGIS-AWS-003 fix).

title: S3 bucket policy allows public principal
description: An Allow statement with Principal "*" grants anonymous access to the bucket, bypassing ACL controls.

title: Security group ingress open to the world
description: Ingress rules allowing 0.0.0.0/0 expose the workload to the entire internet. Restrict source CIDRs to known ranges.
remediation_fix:
Restrict the ingress CIDR to trusted ranges. Replace `0.0.0.0/0` with your
office/VPN CIDRs, or remove the rule and use SSM Session Manager (no inbound
SSH needed):
ingress {
  from_port   = 22
  to_port     = 22
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["203.0.113.0/24"]  # your trusted range
}

title: Security group egress open to the world
description: Egress rules allowing 0.0.0.0/0 permit unrestricted outbound traffic, aiding data exfiltration. Restrict destinations to required ranges.
remediation_fix: Remove public exposure. Restrict ingress to known CIDR ranges, move the resource into private subnets, and front it with a load balancer or API gateway if external access is required. Verify with `aws ec2 describe-security-groups`.

title: IAM policy allows all actions on all resources
description: An Allow statement with Action "*" on Resource "*" is administrative access. Scope actions and resources to least privilege.

title: RDS instance without storage encryption
description: RDS storage should be encrypted at rest. The provider default for storage_encrypted is false, so an absent attribute is a finding.
remediation_fix:
Enable storage encryption on the RDS instance:
resource "aws_db_instance" "this" {
  # ...
  storage_encrypted = true
  kms_key_id        = aws_kms_key.rds.arn  # optional CMK
}
Note: encryption cannot be enabled on an existing unencrypted instance —
take a snapshot, copy it with encryption, and restore.

title: RDS instance without deletion protection
description: Deletion protection guards against accidental database destruction. The provider default is false.

title: EBS volume without encryption
description: EBS volumes should be encrypted at rest. The provider default for encrypted is false, so an absent attribute is a finding.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: CloudTrail without log file validation
description: Log file validation detects tampering with CloudTrail logs after delivery. The provider default for enable_log_file_validation is false, so an absent attribute is a finding.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: RDS instance publicly accessible
description: A publicly accessible database accepts connections from the internet. Keep databases in private subnets with publicly_accessible false (the provider default).
remediation_fix:
Set `publicly_accessible = false` and move the database to private subnets:
resource "aws_db_instance" "this" {
  # ...
  publicly_accessible = false
  db_subnet_group_name = aws_db_subnet_group.private.name
}
Access the database via a bastion host, VPN, or SSM port forwarding — never directly.

title: S3 bucket without versioning
description: Versioning protects against accidental deletion and overwrites and is required for reliable recovery. Provider default is disabled.
remediation_fix: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

title: IAM role assumable by anyone
description: An Allow statement in the trust policy with Principal "*" lets any AWS identity assume this role. Restrict the principal to specific accounts, roles, or services.

title: IAM managed policy grants administrative access
description: An Allow statement with Action "*" (or "iam:*") on Resource "*" is administrative access in a customer-managed policy. Scope actions and resources to least privilege.
remediation_fix:
Replace the admin-managed policy attachment with scoped inline or customer-managed
policies (see AEGIS-AWS-006 fix). If break-glass admin access is required, gate it
behind a separate role with MFA condition and CloudTrail alerting:
Condition = { Bool = { "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent" = "true" } }

title: Public RDS exposure path
description: An RDS instance is publicly accessible AND reachable from the internet through an open security group: a complete network path exists from the internet to the database.
remediation_fix: Remove public exposure. Restrict ingress to known CIDR ranges, move the resource into private subnets, and front it with a load balancer or API gateway if external access is required. Verify with `aws ec2 describe-security-groups`.

title: Public S3 exfiltration path
description: An S3 bucket is readable by the public internet through a bucket policy granting s3:GetObject to everyone, or a public ACL: a complete path exists from the internet to the bucket's data.
remediation_fix:
Break the public exfiltration path. Make the S3 bucket private (see AEGIS-AWS-003
fix), remove the overly permissive IAM policy (see AEGIS-AWS-006 fix), and
ensure the compute role cannot reach public buckets. Treat this as an active
incident path: audit CloudTrail for `s3:GetObject` calls from the affected role.

title: Multi-hop network attack path to database
description: A database is reachable from the internet through a chain of hops — e.g. a world-open security group leading to a second security group, or a compromised EC2 stepping stone sharing the database's security group. No single hop looks critical alone.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Load balancer internet-facing
description: A load balancer with internal absent or false is internet-facing (false is the provider default). Internet-facing LBs widen the attack surface and should be a deliberate choice.

title: Load balancer listener uses plain HTTP
description: A listener terminating plain HTTP sends credentials and session tokens in cleartext. Listeners should use HTTPS (or TLS) with a certificate.

title: Load balancer not dropping invalid headers
description: Without drop_invalid_header_fields, malformed HTTP headers reach targets and enable request-smuggling style attacks. The provider default is false.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: EC2 instance without IMDSv2 enforcement
description: Without metadata_options.http_tokens = "required", the instance metadata service accepts IMDSv1 requests, which SSRF vulnerabilities can abuse to steal credentials.

title: Subnet auto-assigns public IPs
description: map_public_ip_on_launch = true gives every instance in the subnet a public address by default, bypassing the intended private-subnet design.
remediation_fix: Remove public exposure. Restrict ingress to known CIDR ranges, move the resource into private subnets, and front it with a load balancer or API gateway if external access is required. Verify with `aws ec2 describe-security-groups`.

title: S3 bucket without public access block
description: Without an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block enabling all four protections (block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, restrict_public_buckets), a single permissive ACL or policy can expose the bucket. Fail-safe: only a proven all-four-true block silences this rule.
remediation_fix:
Add the public access block resource (see AEGIS-AWS-003 fix). All four settings
must be true for full protection.

title: RDS instance without backup retention
description: With backup_retention_period absent or 0, automated backups are disabled and point-in-time recovery is impossible after data loss.
remediation_fix: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

title: ElastiCache replication group without snapshots
description: With snapshot_retention_limit absent or 0, automated snapshots are disabled and cache data cannot be restored after loss.
remediation_fix: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

title: VPC without flow logs
description: Without an aws_flow_log attached to the VPC, network traffic metadata is not captured and incident investigation is blind. Fail-safe: a VPC with no linked flow log is flagged. VPCs with no subnets carry no traffic and are skipped.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: Launch template EBS volumes unencrypted
description: A block_device_mappings entry in an aws_launch_template whose ebs map has encrypted = false leaves the volume readable at rest. (Known false only; absent follows the provider default.)
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: ECS task definition with privileged container
description: A container with privileged = true in container_definitions runs with all host capabilities, escaping container isolation.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: ECR repository without image scanning
description: Without image_scanning_configuration { scan_on_push = true }, vulnerable images are pushed and deployed without any scan.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: EKS cluster without secrets encryption
description: Without an encryption_config block, Kubernetes secrets are stored in etcd encrypted only with an AWS-owned key instead of a customer-managed KMS key.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: EKS cluster with public endpoint
description: vpc_config.endpoint_public_access = true exposes the Kubernetes API server to the public internet.

title: EKS cluster without control plane logging
description: Without enabled_cluster_log_types, EKS control-plane audit and authenticator logs are not sent to CloudWatch, blinding incident response.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: Lambda function env vars without KMS
description: An environment block with variables but no kms_key_arn leaves environment variables (often secrets) encrypted only with an AWS-owned key.

title: Lambda without active X-Ray tracing
description: Without tracing_config { mode = "Active" }, Lambda invocations are not traced in X-Ray, reducing observability of failures and latency.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Deprecated launch configuration in use
description: aws_launch_configuration is deprecated by AWS; migrate to aws_launch_template, which receives new features and supports versioning.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: EC2 instance without detailed monitoring
description: With monitoring absent or false (the provider default), the instance ships only basic 5-minute CloudWatch metrics, delaying detection of performance and availability issues.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: RDS without IAM database authentication
description: With iam_database_authentication_enabled absent or false, database access relies on long-lived passwords instead of short-lived IAM credentials, weakening credential hygiene.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: DynamoDB table without point-in-time recovery
description: Without a point_in_time_recovery block, DynamoDB continuous backups are disabled and the table cannot be restored to an arbitrary point in the preceding 35 days.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: DynamoDB table without customer-managed encryption
description: AWS encrypts DynamoDB tables at rest by default with AWS-owned keys; this rule treats a missing server_side_encryption block as insufficient because AWS-owned keys offer no customer control over key rotation or revocation. Set server_side_encryption { enabled = true, kms_key_arn = ... }.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: Redshift cluster unencrypted
description: Redshift clusters are unencrypted unless encrypted = true; unencrypted clusters expose data at rest on cluster storage.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: Redshift cluster publicly accessible
description: A publicly_accessible Redshift cluster accepts connections from the internet, exposing the data warehouse to network attacks.
remediation_fix: Remove public exposure. Restrict ingress to known CIDR ranges, move the resource into private subnets, and front it with a load balancer or API gateway if external access is required. Verify with `aws ec2 describe-security-groups`.

title: Redshift cluster without audit logging
description: Without a logging block, Redshift audit logs are not delivered to S3, leaving connection and query activity unrecorded for forensics and compliance.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: EFS file system unencrypted
description: EFS file systems are unencrypted unless encrypted = true; unencrypted file systems expose data at rest.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: OpenSearch domain without node-to-node encryption
description: Without node_to_node_encryption { enabled = true }, traffic between cluster nodes is unencrypted and observable on the network.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: OpenSearch domain without encryption at rest
description: Without encrypt_at_rest { enabled = true }, indexed data is stored unencrypted on domain volumes.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: ElastiCache replication group without transit encryption
description: With transit_encryption_enabled absent or false, data in transit between the application and the cache is unencrypted.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: ElastiCache replication group without at-rest encryption
description: With at_rest_encryption_enabled absent or false, cached data and snapshots are stored unencrypted.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: Aurora cluster without backup retention
description: With backup_retention_period absent or 0, automated backups are disabled and the Aurora cluster cannot be restored after data loss.
remediation_fix: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

title: Load balancer without deletion protection
description: Without enable_deletion_protection, a load balancer can be destroyed by a single API call or Terraform change, taking the service offline. The provider default is disabled.

title: Load balancer listener with weak TLS policy
description: A TLS listener using a pre-TLS-1.2 security policy (e.g. ELBSecurityPolicy-2016-08) negotiates weak cipher suites. Use a TLS 1.2+ policy such as ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: CloudFront distribution allows HTTP
description: A cache behavior with viewer_protocol_policy = "allow-all" serves content over unencrypted HTTP. Use "https-only" or "redirect-to-https".

title: API Gateway custom domain with weak TLS
description: A custom domain name with security_policy below TLS_1_2 (e.g. TLS_1_0) negotiates weak cipher suites. The modern provider default is TLS_1_2.
remediation_fix: Enforce TLS 1.2+. Replace HTTP listeners with HTTPS, set a modern TLS policy (e.g. `ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06`), and redirect HTTP→HTTPS. Disable weak ciphers and old protocol versions everywhere.

title: API Gateway stage without access logging
description: A stage without an access_log_settings block leaves no audit trail of API invocations, hampering incident response and anomaly detection.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: Network ACL with open ingress
description: An inline NACL ingress rule allowing 0.0.0.0/0 exposes the subnet to the internet at the stateless network layer. NACLs are a coarse control; restrict ingress to known ranges.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Load balancer target group uses plain HTTP
description: A target group with protocol = "HTTP" forwards traffic to targets unencrypted, exposing internal traffic on the network. Use HTTPS for backend connections.
remediation_fix: Enforce TLS 1.2+. Replace HTTP listeners with HTTPS, set a modern TLS policy (e.g. `ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06`), and redirect HTTP→HTTPS. Disable weak ciphers and old protocol versions everywhere.

title: CloudFront distribution without WAF
description: A distribution with no web_acl_id attached has no WAFv2 protection against common web exploits and bots at the edge.
remediation_fix:
Attach a WAFv2 Web ACL with managed rule groups (AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet,
AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet) to the load balancer / API / distribution.
Set the default action to block and monitor via CloudWatch metrics.

title: Network ACL rule with open ingress
description: A standalone aws_network_acl_rule allowing 0.0.0.0/0 ingress exposes the subnet to the internet at the stateless network layer. Restrict ingress to known ranges.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: API Gateway v2 stage without access logging
description: A v2 (HTTP/WebSocket) stage without an access_log_settings block leaves no audit trail of API invocations, hampering incident response and anomaly detection.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: Inline admin policy attached to role/user/group
description: An inline IAM policy with an Allow statement granting Action "*" (or "*:*") on Resource "*" is administrative access. Inline policies are harder to audit than managed ones; scope them to least privilege.
remediation_fix:
Move the inline admin policy to a scoped customer-managed policy (see
AEGIS-AWS-006 fix). Inline policies on identities are hard to audit — prefer
managed policies attached to groups/roles.

title: Weak or absent account password policy
description: The IAM account password policy is the baseline for human credentials. A short minimum length, missing character-class requirements, or disabled password-reuse prevention weakens every console login in the account.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: KMS key without rotation
description: Customer-managed KMS keys should rotate annually. enable_key_rotation defaults to false. (AWS-managed keys rotate automatically and cannot set this flag; a narrow false positive is possible if an AWS-managed key is declared explicitly.)

title: CloudTrail not multi-region
description: A single-region trail misses API activity in every other region. is_multi_region_trail defaults to false.
remediation_fix:
Enable CloudTrail in all regions with log file validation:
resource "aws_cloudtrail" "this" {
  is_multi_region_trail         = true
  enable_log_file_validation    = true
  kms_key_id                    = aws_kms_key.cloudtrail.arn
  s3_bucket_name                = aws_s3_bucket.trail.id
  include_global_service_events = true
}

title: Secrets Manager rotation interval too long
description: A Secrets Manager rotation interval above 90 days keeps a compromised credential usable for too long. Rotation cadence is configured on aws_secretsmanager_secret_rotation via rotation_rules.
remediation_fix: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Store secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and reference them via data sources. Never commit secrets to version control — scan history with gitleaks if the value was ever committed.

title: SSM parameter stores plaintext secret

title: Hardcoded credentials in resource config
description: A database password written as a literal in Terraform config is stored in state, plan output, and version control. The same holds for a secret-like variable or local flowing into a credential attribute. Reference a secrets manager or a generated password instead. The secret value is never included in findings.
remediation_fix:
Remove the hardcoded credential and rotate it immediately — it is compromised.
Reference a Secrets Manager secret instead:
data "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "db" {
  secret_id = aws_secretsmanager_secret.db.id
}
# then: password = jsondecode(data.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.db.secret_string)["password"]
If the value was committed to git, purge it from history (BFG/truffleHog) and rotate.

remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: API Gateway API key hardcoded in config
description: An API key written as a literal in Terraform config is stored in state and version control. Let AWS generate the key or source it from a secrets manager. The key value is never included in findings.
remediation_fix: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Store secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and reference them via data sources. Never commit secrets to version control — scan history with gitleaks if the value was ever committed.

title: EC2 instance EBS volumes unencrypted
description: An ebs_block_device entry in an aws_instance whose encrypted attribute is false leaves the volume readable at rest. (Known false only; absent follows the provider default.)
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: ECS task definition with host networking
description: network_mode = "host" gives containers full access to the host network namespace, bypassing Docker network isolation.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Secrets Manager version with hardcoded secret
description: A secret_string written as a literal in Terraform config is stored in state, plan output, and version control — defeating the purpose of Secrets Manager. Generate it or reference it instead. The secret value is never included in findings.
remediation_fix: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Store secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and reference them via data sources. Never commit secrets to version control — scan history with gitleaks if the value was ever committed.

title: SNS subscription over plaintext HTTP
description: An SNS subscription using the http protocol delivers message content unencrypted in transit. Use https.
remediation_fix: Enforce TLS 1.2+. Replace HTTP listeners with HTTPS, set a modern TLS policy (e.g. `ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06`), and redirect HTTP→HTTPS. Disable weak ciphers and old protocol versions everywhere.

description: Without an explicit Deny on aws:SecureTransport=false, bucket objects can be fetched over plaintext HTTP. Add a bucket policy statement denying s3:* when SecureTransport is false.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: EC2 instance with public IP address
description: An instance with associate_public_ip_address=true is directly reachable from the internet. Use a load balancer or bastion instead.

title: S3 bucket without server access logging
description: Server access logging records requests against the bucket, which is essential for audit and incident response.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: RDS instance without Multi-AZ
description: Single-AZ RDS instances have no standby for failover. Enable multi_az for production databases.

title: IAM policy allows privilege escalation (create policy + attach policy)
description: The policy combines a policy-authoring action (iam:CreatePolicy, iam:PutRolePolicy, iam:PutUserPolicy, iam:PutGroupPolicy) with a policy-attachment action (iam:AttachRolePolicy, iam:AttachUserPolicy, iam:AttachGroupPolicy). Attack path: create an administrative policy, attach it to your own role/user, assume full admin. Split authoring from attachment duties and scope each to least privilege.
remediation_fix:
Split policy authoring from attachment (this combination is the classic privilege
escalation primitive). Remove `iam:CreatePolicy*` / `iam:Attach*Policy` from the
workload policy. Policy management belongs in a separate, human-gated CI/CD role —
never in an application runtime role.

title: IAM policy allows privilege escalation via iam:PassRole on * with compute launch
description: The policy allows iam:PassRole on "*" together with a role-assumption primitive (ec2:RunInstances, lambda:CreateFunction, lambda:UpdateFunctionCode, ...). Attack path: launch a compute resource passing an administrative role, then steal its credentials from the instance metadata / environment. Scope iam:PassRole to specific role ARNs.
remediation_fix:
Scope `iam:PassRole` to the exact role ARNs the workload must pass, and only
together with the specific compute-launch action it needs:
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "iam:PassRole",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AppExecutionRole"
}
Never grant `iam:PassRole` on `*` — it lets the holder escalate to any role.

title: IAM policy allows data exfiltration primitives
description: The policy grants a known exfiltration pair: s3:GetObject + s3:PutObject on "*" (copy data to an attacker bucket), rds:CreateDBSnapshot + rds:ModifyDBSnapshotAttribute (share a snapshot cross-account), or ec2:CreateSnapshot + ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute (share an EBS snapshot). Attack path: snapshot or copy production data, share it outside the account. Scope data-plane actions to specific resources.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: IAM permissions management actions allowed on all resources
description: An Allow statement grants IAM write actions (iam:Put*, iam:Create*, iam:Update*, iam:Delete*, iam:Attach*, iam:Detach*, or iam:*) on Resource "*". Attack path: modify any identity's policies directly to escalate to admin. Read-only IAM actions (iam:Get*, iam:List*, iam:Generate*, iam:Simulate*) are excluded. Scope IAM management to specific users, roles, and policies.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: Write actions allowed on all resources
description: An Allow statement grants write actions (*:Put*, *:Create*, *:Update*, *:Delete*, *:Modify*) on Resource "*". Attack path: unconstrained writes let an attacker reconfigure, exfiltrate from, or destroy any resource in the account. The blanket Action "*" case is owned by AEGIS-AWS-006. Scope write actions to the resources the workload actually manages.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Default security group allows traffic from anywhere
description: The default security group of a VPC should not allow ingress or egress to/from 0.0.0.0/0. Default groups are attached implicitly, so overly permissive rules expose every associated resource. Applies only to aws_default_security_group, never to regular aws_security_group resources.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Secrets in EC2 user_data
description: A secret (AWS key, password, token) embedded in EC2 user_data is visible in the console, API responses, and instance metadata. user_data_base64 is decoded before scanning. Pass secrets via instance profiles, SSM Parameter Store, or Secrets Manager instead. The secret value is never included in findings.
remediation_fix:
Remove secrets from user_data immediately and rotate every exposed value.
Pass secrets via instance tags + Secrets Manager lookup at boot, or use an IAM
instance profile so the instance fetches secrets at runtime:
user_data = base64encode(templatefile("bootstrap.sh", {}))  # no secrets inside
Note: user_data is visible to anyone with EC2 DescribeInstances — treat any
secret ever placed there as compromised.

title: Plaintext password in provisioner connection
description: A provisioner connection block with a hardcoded password stores credentials in Terraform state and version control. Use SSH keys, bastion hosts, or a secrets manager instead. The secret value is never included in findings.
remediation_fix: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Store secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and reference them via data sources. Never commit secrets to version control — scan history with gitleaks if the value was ever committed.

title: Sensitive value exposed in Terraform output
description: A Terraform output with a secret-like name (password, secret, key, token) that is not marked sensitive exposes the value in CLI output, state files, and CI logs. Set sensitive = true. The secret value is never included in findings.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Secret stored in resource tags
description: A resource tag with a secret-like key (password, secret, token) and a non-empty value exposes credentials in the console, APIs, and cost reports. Tags are not a secrets store. The secret value is never included in findings.
remediation_fix: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Store secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and reference them via data sources. Never commit secrets to version control — scan history with gitleaks if the value was ever committed.

title: Secret in plaintext variable default
description: A Terraform variable with a secret-like name (password, secret, token) and a hardcoded plaintext default bakes the credential into version control. Leave the default empty and inject via a secrets manager, vault provider, or CI secret. The secret value is never included in findings.
remediation_fix: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Store secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and reference them via data sources. Never commit secrets to version control — scan history with gitleaks if the value was ever committed.

title: Secret in hardcoded local value
description: A Terraform local with a secret-like name (password, secret, token) and a hardcoded string value bakes the credential into version control and state. Reference a secrets manager instead. The secret value is never included in findings.
remediation_fix: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Store secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and reference them via data sources. Never commit secrets to version control — scan history with gitleaks if the value was ever committed.

title: RDS MySQL/Postgres instance without IAM database authentication
description: MySQL and Postgres RDS instances support IAM database authentication, which replaces long-lived passwords with short-lived IAM credentials. With iam_database_authentication_enabled absent or false, access relies on static passwords. Engine-scoped: only fires for mysql/postgres engines; aurora and unknown engines are out of scope.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: Launch configuration allows IMDSv1
description: Without metadata_options.http_tokens = "required", instances launched from this configuration accept IMDSv1 requests, which SSRF vulnerabilities can abuse to steal credentials. AEGIS-AWS-204 covers aws_instance and aws_launch_template; this rule closes the gap for aws_launch_configuration.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Lambda function not deployed in a VPC
description: Lambda functions without a vpc_config block run outside your VPC, with no security-group or network-ACL control over their network access. Functions accessing VPC resources (RDS, ElastiCache) should declare vpc_config with subnet_ids and security_group_ids.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: RDS instance without CloudWatch log exports
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should export database logs to CloudWatch via enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports for auditing and troubleshooting. Without log exports, forensic analysis after an incident is limited.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: RDS instance without auto minor version upgrades
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should enable auto_minor_version_upgrade so security patches are applied automatically during maintenance windows. Without it, the engine can drift behind on security fixes.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: RDS instance without copy_tags_to_snapshot
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should copy tags to snapshots so backup resources inherit cost-allocation and ownership tags. Set copy_tags_to_snapshot = true.
remediation_fix: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

title: Lambda function without X-Ray active tracing
description: Hygiene: Lambda functions should enable X-Ray active tracing for distributed request observability. Add a tracing_config block with mode = "Active".
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Lambda function without reserved concurrent executions
description: Hygiene: Lambda functions should set reserved_concurrent_executions to cap concurrency, preventing runaway scaling and unexpected cost. Set the attribute explicitly.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: ElastiCache replication group without at-rest encryption
description: ElastiCache replication groups should encrypt data at rest to protect cached sensitive data. Set at_rest_encryption_enabled = true.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: ElastiCache replication group without in-transit encryption
description: ElastiCache replication groups should encrypt data in transit to protect cached data on the wire. Set transit_encryption_enabled = true.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: ElastiCache replication group without Multi-AZ / failover
description: Hygiene: ElastiCache replication groups should enable Multi-AZ with automatic failover for high availability. Set multi_az_enabled = true and automatic_failover_enabled = true.

title: IAM access key created without PGP encryption
description: IAM access keys should be created with pgp_key so the secret access key is encrypted at creation. Without it, the plaintext secret is stored in Terraform state. Set pgp_key to a PGP public key.
remediation_fix:
Rotate IAM access keys every 90 days or less. Prefer short-lived credentials:
federate via IAM Identity Center / SSO, or use instance profiles and ECS task roles
instead of long-lived keys. Audit with IAM Access Analyzer unused-access findings.

title: IAM policy uses NotAction with Allow effect
description: Combining "NotAction" with "Effect": "Allow" creates a deny-bypass pattern: the policy allows everything EXCEPT the listed actions, which is the inverse of least privilege. Rewrite using explicit Action lists.
remediation_fix:
Replace `NotAction` + `Allow` with explicit `Action` lists. NotAction inverts
matching and is easy to misread — enumerate exactly what the identity may do
(see AEGIS-AWS-006 fix).

title: IAM role with max session duration over 12 hours
description: IAM roles should limit max_session_duration to 12 hours (43200 seconds) or less. Longer sessions increase the window for credential misuse if temporary credentials are compromised. Set max_session_duration <= 43200.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: IAM group inline policy grants wildcard admin
description: IAM group inline policies should not grant "Action": "*" on "Resource": "*". Group membership changes silently expand the blast radius. Use managed policies with scoped permissions instead.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: Transit Gateway route table propagation enabled
description: Transit Gateway route table propagation automatically spreads routes from attachments, which can unintentionally expose VPCs to each other. Review each aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation and disable it where cross-VPC routing is not required.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: VPC endpoint policy allows all principals
description: VPC endpoint policies with "Principal": "*" allow any AWS principal to use the endpoint, defeating the purpose of private connectivity. Scope the Principal to specific accounts or roles.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: S3 bucket with force_destroy enabled
description: Hygiene: force_destroy = true allows Terraform to delete a bucket even when it contains objects, risking data loss. Remove force_destroy or set it to false for production buckets.

title: KMS key with deletion window under 7 days
description: KMS keys should use a deletion window of at least 7 days (AWS minimum) so accidental deletion can be cancelled. Longer windows (30 days) are recommended. Set deletion_window_in_days >= 7.

title: KMS grant with wildcard operations
description: KMS grants should list only the specific operations the grantee needs. Wildcard operations delegate full key control. Replace "*" with the minimal operation set.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: Secrets Manager secret without customer-managed KMS key
description: Secrets Manager secrets should use a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_id) instead of the default AWS-managed key, so key rotation and access policies are under your control. Set kms_key_id.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: Lambda function with explicitly unlimited concurrency
description: Setting reserved_concurrent_executions = -1 explicitly opts out of concurrency limits, allowing unbounded scaling and runaway cost. (Absent values are covered by AEGIS-AWS-548 hygiene.) Set an explicit positive limit.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: EC2 instance with EBS optimization explicitly disabled
description: Hygiene: EC2 instances should enable EBS optimization for dedicated EBS throughput. Only flags explicitly disabled (ebs_optimized = false); unset values follow instance-type defaults.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: RDS Performance Insights without customer-managed KMS key
description: When Performance Insights is enabled, its data should be encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key rather than the default AWS key. Set performance_insights_kms_key_id.
remediation_fix: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

title: Security Hub not enabled in module
description: AWS Security Hub should be enabled for centralized security findings aggregation and CIS benchmark checks. Add an aws_securityhub_account resource. Only evaluated on modules with 5+ resources to avoid noise on trivial configurations.

title: CloudTrail trail without KMS encryption
description: CloudTrail log files should be encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key so log integrity is under your control. Set kms_key_id on the aws_cloudtrail resource.

title: Amazon Detective not enabled in module
description: Amazon Detective should be enabled for ML-driven security investigation across CloudTrail, VPC flow logs, and GuardDuty findings. Add an aws_detective_graph resource. Only evaluated on modules with 5+ resources to avoid noise on trivial configurations.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: CloudTrail S3 bucket without MFA delete protection
description: Hygiene: S3 buckets storing CloudTrail logs should enable MFA delete on versioning so log tampering requires MFA. Set mfa_delete = "Enabled" in the aws_s3_bucket_versioning configuration.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: CodeArtifact repository without upstream configuration
description: CodeArtifact repositories should declare upstream repositories explicitly so package provenance is controlled. A repository without an upstream block may pull from unexpected external sources. Add an upstream block.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: S3 bucket without lifecycle configuration
description: Hygiene: S3 buckets should define lifecycle rules to transition or expire objects, controlling long-term storage costs. Add a lifecycle_rule block or an aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration resource.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Security group or rule without description
description: Hygiene: Security groups and their rules should carry descriptions so reviewers understand their purpose. Add a description attribute.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: RDS instance without enhanced monitoring
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should enable enhanced monitoring (monitoring_interval > 0) for OS-level metrics that aid troubleshooting. Set monitoring_interval to 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: RDS Postgres instance without query logging
description: Hygiene: RDS Postgres instances should export postgresql logs to CloudWatch for query auditing. Add "postgresql" to enabled_cloudwatch_logs_log_exports.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: RDS instance without Performance Insights
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should enable Performance Insights for query-level performance analysis. Set performance_insights_enabled = true.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Load balancer without access logging
description: Hygiene: Load balancers should log access to S3 for traffic analysis and incident investigation. Add an access_logs block with a bucket.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: CloudWatch log group without retention period
description: Hygiene: CloudWatch log groups should set retention_in_days so logs expire on a schedule instead of accumulating forever. Set retention_in_days explicitly.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: Neptune cluster without CloudWatch log exports
description: Hygiene: Neptune clusters should export audit logs to CloudWatch. Set enable_cloudwatch_logs_exports (e.g. ["audit"]).
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: Neptune cluster without adequate backup retention
description: Hygiene: Neptune clusters should retain automated backups for at least 7 days. Set backup_retention_period >= 7.
remediation_fix: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

title: WAFv2 web ACL without logging configuration
description: Hygiene: WAFv2 web ACLs should log to CloudWatch/S3/Kinesis for request analysis. Add an aws_wafv2_web_acl_logging_configuration resource.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: AppSync GraphQL API without logging
description: Hygiene: AppSync APIs should enable field-level logging to CloudWatch. Add a log_config block.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: MQ broker without audit logging
description: Hygiene: MQ brokers should enable audit logging for administrative actions. Set logs { audit = true }.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: CodeBuild project without logging configuration
description: Hygiene: CodeBuild projects should log builds to CloudWatch and/or S3. Add a logs_config block.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: Elasticsearch domain without audit logging
description: Hygiene: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch domains should publish audit logs. Add a log_publishing_options block with log_type AUDIT_LOGS.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: MQ broker without general logging
description: Hygiene: MQ brokers should enable general logging for operational visibility. Set logs { general = true }.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: Redshift cluster without audit logging
description: Hygiene: Redshift clusters should log to S3 for audit trails. Add a logging block with a bucket.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: MSK cluster without logging
description: Hygiene: MSK clusters should enable broker logging to CloudWatch, S3 or Firehose. Add a logging_info block.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: Elasticsearch domain without any log publishing
description: Hygiene: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch domains should publish at least one log type (search, index, error or audit). Add a log_publishing_options block. (Audit-specific coverage: AEGIS-AWS-618.)
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: DocumentDB cluster without CloudWatch log exports
description: Hygiene: DocumentDB clusters should export profiler and audit logs to CloudWatch. Set enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: CloudFront distribution without access logging
description: Hygiene: CloudFront distributions should log access to S3 for traffic analysis. Add a logging_config block with a bucket.
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: DocumentDB cluster without adequate backup retention
description: Hygiene: DocumentDB clusters should retain automated backups for at least 7 days. Set backup_retention_period >= 7.
remediation_fix: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

title: Full kill chain: internet to data store
description: A complete, evidence-backed attack path exists from the internet through a workload to a sensitive data store. Each hop cites the Terraform resource and attribute that enables it. Uncertain hops are explicitly marked, never invented.
remediation_fix:
Break the kill chain at the cheapest hop. Recommended order:
1. Close the entry point (restrict the security group / remove public ingress).
2. Scope the IAM role to least privilege (see AEGIS-AWS-006 fix).
3. Move the data store to private subnets with no public route.
Re-run `aegis scan --attack-paths` to confirm the chain is gone.

title: IAM privilege chain: workload inherits sensitive actions
description: A workload (EC2, Lambda) assumes an IAM role whose policy grants wildcard or sensitive actions. The chain traces role → policy → workload with evidence at each hop, showing the exact privilege inheritance path an attacker would abuse.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

title: RDS Cluster without audit logging
description: An Aurora cluster whose enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports does not include audit logging has no record of database authentication and query activity, leaving malicious or anomalous access undetectable.

title: Aurora cluster without backtracking enabled
description: Aurora MySQL backtracking rewinds the cluster to a point in time without a restore; with backtrack_window at 0 it is disabled and recovery from bad writes requires a slower snapshot restore.

title: RDS Cluster not configured to copy tags to snapshots
description: With copy_tags_to_snapshot absent or false, snapshots lose the cluster's tags, breaking cost allocation, ownership tracking, and tag-based access controls on restored data.

title: RDS Cluster not encrypted with customer-managed KMS key
description: An encrypted Aurora cluster with no kms_key_id uses the default AWS-managed key; a customer-managed key (CMK) gives control over key rotation, grants, and audit trail.

title: RDS Cluster without Performance Insights
description: With performance_insights_enabled absent or false, the cluster provides no query-level performance telemetry, slowing detection of abusive or anomalous database workloads.

title: RDS Cluster without enhanced monitoring
description: With monitoring_interval at 0 or absent, the cluster emits only basic CloudWatch metrics; enhanced monitoring (1-60s granularity) is needed to spot OS-level anomalies such as unexpected connections.

title: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch domain without HTTPS enforcement
description: A search domain whose domain_endpoint_options does not set enforce_https = true serves the cluster endpoint over plaintext HTTP, exposing credentials and query data in transit.
remediation_fix: Enforce TLS 1.2+. Replace HTTP listeners with HTTPS, set a modern TLS policy (e.g. `ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06`), and redirect HTTP→HTTPS. Disable weak ciphers and old protocol versions everywhere.

title: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch domain without dedicated master nodes
description: A search domain whose cluster_config does not set dedicated_master_enabled = true runs cluster coordination on data nodes, risking split-brain and instability under load. Use dedicated master nodes for production domains.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch domain without zone awareness
description: A search domain whose cluster_config does not set zone_awareness_enabled = true places all nodes in one availability zone: a zone failure takes the domain down. Enable zone awareness for multi-AZ resilience.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: OpenSearch domain without internal user database
description: An OpenSearch domain whose advanced_security_options does not set internal_user_database_enabled = true has no built-in master user store, weakening fine-grained access control. Enable the internal user database.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch domain without snapshot configuration
description: Hygiene: a search domain without a snapshot_options block has no configured automated snapshot schedule, slowing recovery from data loss or corruption. Set automated_snapshot_start_hour.
remediation_fix: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

title: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch domain without slow logs
description: Hygiene: a search domain whose log_publishing_options publish neither SEARCH_SLOW_LOGS nor INDEX_SLOW_LOGS hides expensive queries, blinding performance tuning and abuse detection. Publish slow logs. (Audit-specific coverage: AEGIS-AWS-618; any-log coverage: AEGIS-AWS-623.)
remediation_fix: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

title: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch domain on an end-of-life engine version
description: A search domain pinned to an end-of-life engine version (Elasticsearch below 7.x) no longer receives security patches. Upgrade to a supported engine version.
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Elasticsearch domain without fine-grained access control
description: An aws_elasticsearch_domain without advanced_security_options (enabled = true) has no fine-grained access control: any principal reaching the endpoint can read and write any index. Enable advanced security with a master user. (OpenSearch coverage: AEGIS-AWS-418/523.)
remediation_fix: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

title: Lambda function without code signing
description: An aws_lambda_function without a code_signing_config block deploys code without signature validation, so tampered deployment packages run unchecked. Enforce code signing with AWS Signer.

title: Lambda function on an end-of-life runtime

title: Lambda function with plaintext secret in environment variables
description: An aws_lambda_function environment variable holding a value that looks like a live credential (AWS key, 40-char secret, or long mixed token) exposes the secret to anyone with read access to the function configuration. Reference secrets from AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store instead.
remediation_fix: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Store secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and reference them via data sources. Never commit secrets to version control — scan history with gitleaks if the value was ever committed.

title: IAM password policy minimum length below 14
description: The account password policy allows passwords shorter than 14 characters. Short minimum lengths make console passwords far easier to brute-force. Set minimum_password_length to 14 or more.
remediation_fix: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.
